∀ {K C : Type} (ix : K → List Bool) {es : List (K × C)} {e : K × C}, e ∈ es → ∃ x ∈ es, Minidregg.Kernel.WorldRoot.slotsOf ix es (ix e.1) = Option.some x ∧ ix x.1 = ix e.1
